claims.statement: The built-in personal Assistant has one persistent canonical identity with independent personal conversation topics. It initializes idle from My Assistant, shares configuration, teams and wakes, and uses native Codex as executor without a new database schema.

The selected Assistant can create an independent persistent Agent under an exact delivered user delegation. Initial instructions retain application provenance and linked user authority. Existing Work and scoped Collaboration own outcome assignment and assessment.

The existing service tick delivers independent duties through the Inbox. Turn preparation injects a compact Work directory; fresh contexts receive current state and recent original exchanges across native contexts instead of recursive summaries.
Native memory inspection reads an already-loaded thread without generation or policy changes; isolated native tests set memory generation and use independently in thread-start configuration.

Renewal defaults to 24 completed turns and an 80 percent native-context pressure trigger when enabled. Safe boundaries retain native request, Goal, voice, retry and child ownership. Exact question answers and canonical edited inputs remain in their original native context.

Renewal records intent before a clean native thread/start, saves the acknowledgment before dependent work, atomically changes the stable Agent binding and retains old history. Unknown creation uses exact loaded native source markers for reconciliation and is never blindly repeated.

Confirmed Assistant successors retain a usable draft editor, loaded history and reading state. Saved drafts follow only that Assistant's recorded lineage, including after restart; submitted commands and history references keep exact identities. Cursors and logical positions retain native sources, whose decimal position keys decode through tagged JSON replies. Retired rows stay read-only and context retirement does not run Agent archive cleanup.

RAGFlow checks Docker and Compose before installation, prepares managed nightly and opens setup when models are absent. Its four-field editor shares the Base URL and optional API key across extraction and embedding model IDs. Save verifies both models before dedicated Memory setup. New Memory connections enable automatic learning; existing saved choices survive updates. Empty dataset scopes disable knowledge retrieval. No model runtime or weights are installed.

External Memory contexts disable native memory generation, use and the memories feature, set native memory mode disabled and preserve that policy on cold resume. The retiring current thread gets disabled memory mode without deleting existing native memories or editing shared defaults and unrelated Agents.

RAGFlow requests enforce exact scopes, bounded time and size, and HTTP plus business-result checks. Completed public chat imports run one at a time outside the actor. Unknown effects are not automatically resent; queued extraction is not searchable completion.

Database, desktop and selected-native fixtures check independent personal topics with shared settings, topic-local user authority, deletion and empty-topic discard, separate drafts, fresh contexts without fork or extra creation inference, personal tools and project isolation. Existing fixtures also cover renewal, teams, wakes and Memory receipts. These fixtures do not qualify a live RAGFlow instance or installed visual behavior.

A saved Assistant mandate requests safe context renewal even with periodic renewal disabled. Chat import starts a new opt-in boundary when the external instance, Memory or user scope changes, so earlier pending exchanges are not exported into a new user namespace.

Assistant context history skips internal realtime delegation and intermediate commentary, retains public messages and native turn anchors, and preserves inherited native reasoning effort in fresh contexts.

HTTP Memory setup fixtures cover missing default models without publishing a Memory credential, exact-name recovery after a lost creation reply, and origin-bound credentials with private file modes. Idle setup has no first user event. Managed-service fixtures cover unavailable container prerequisites without storage changes, image pulls or service startup, loopback-only exposure, absence of model installation, custom endpoint paths and names, loopback translation and project-scoped Uninstall without volume removal. The model editor fixtures check blank saved-key fields, same-endpoint key retention, source invalidation, draft preservation, empty-submit blocking, explicit URL validation and input-driven form updates.

First Assistant setup seeds the existing per-Agent next-message choices from the available displayed model and effort, the new-conversation permission default and the shared speed preference. The configured first send carries them without changing the previous Agent or its saved draft.

RAGFlow uses shared component lifecycle controls and displays its complete server-reported version. Receipts and the UI retain the original server version directly. Update retains models, credentials, data and the saved import choice; Uninstall clears the Assistant connection and stops only the owned Compose project while retaining volumes and private installation identity for reinstall.
RAGFlow configuration requires an origin-bound private component credential reference; the service reads that credential file for Memory calls and has no environment-variable credential path.

Reset Memory binds confirmation to the reviewed managed Memory, checks its private receipt, origin and Assistant namespace, and replaces only that Memory through the native RAGFlow API with saved model IDs. It retains credentials, models, chat history, explicit datasets, service volumes and the current automatic-learning choice. A new export boundary prevents old-history replay. Reset does not promise in-place reindexing or physical erasure.

After native delete succeeds, reset persists a receipt without the old Memory before initializing its replacement. Failed replacement keeps model settings and credentials for Edit and Save recovery. An already missing resource is accepted only by the reset delete path for the exact confirmed target; other response callers report missing resources as errors.

Changing the configured Memory clears its previous health notice. Import health updates carry their original connection and are ignored when it no longer matches the current settings, so a late previous-Memory result cannot label the new Memory.

Automatic learning uses only completed original user/final-Assistant dialogue after its saved boundary, skips recognized credentials and nonpublic native items, excludes turns with explicit remember or forget receipts, and rechecks the current Assistant connection before writing.

Normal Assistant turns receive bounded personal recall through native untrusted additionalContext with exact Memory/Assistant/user scope, a five-second timeout, a 2,048-character query and up to five 1,200-character results; ordinary project Agents do not receive this context.

Export selection matches saved Memory, native thread and turn fields in operation receipts. A reserved exchange, including an unknown write, is not selected again and does not block later completed exchanges after restart.

New managed Memories use Raw and Semantic types with an Assistant-specific extraction prompt for explicit durable work preferences, requirements, constraints and user background. The prompt excludes unrelated general knowledge, inferred preferences, quoted or temporary material, credentials and transient task status, preserves the user's meaning and language, and limits native Semantic JSON output to five items. Recovery of an existing Memory preserves its saved prompt.

The explicit offline development reset combines registered native contexts and Decodex-origin session metadata, reads each target before native deletion, resets managed Memory and clears conversation, Work, team, duty and execution state. It preserves accounts, credentials, account policy, model defaults and project configuration, removes drafts, blobs, cache, database backups and logs, and submits no native inference turn.

The assistant-init CLI command uses the existing CreateAssistant action to initialize an idle built-in Assistant without a first message. An explicit development cutover can then configure the new managed Memory and use fresh role-specific native contexts rather than retained legacy declarations.

An initialized idle Assistant remains visible without a native context or archive lookup. Startup skips an unused root until saved execution settings or a pending first input exists, so an empty Assistant reports no configuration error and does not block a later project conversation.

Deleting a personal conversation removes its recorded native contexts and local conversation text and drafts while retaining canonical Assistant configuration and learned Memory. A deleted separate topic is removed from active lists; independent Work can retain only its content-free retired identity. Deletion starts no turn and does not reimport deleted history.

CreateAssistantTopic atomically records a separate idle personal conversation under an existing canonical Assistant; the first submitted input starts a fresh native context without a fork, copied dialogue or an extra inference call at creation.

Explicit personal topic membership shares canonical Assistant configuration and RAGFlow agent scope while preserving source-topic user authority and session receipts. Topic aliases are excluded from the public Agent catalog and teams; project Agents remain outside the personal Memory tool and recall boundary.

assistant_read supplies global Work headers to personal conversations, while detailed Work evidence and mutations retain their existing original-conversation authority and do not grant private-chat access.
The current runtime lock and qualification identify the selected development artifact. Native qualification uses an explicit exact binary; upstream main is not a substitute for installed capability.

The Assistant hover-plus and global New Assistant topic command reuse an eligible unstarted personal draft and preserve its input instead of creating repeated empty topics. Unstarted topics use an ordinary label without a Draft suffix; an empty canonical identity appears only when selected, retaining input or bound to a native thread.

Sidebar archive verifies an exact idle native binding, submits native thread/archive and confirms archived state before local retirement. Confirmed active-conversation deletion archives first and reuses the existing durable deletion plan, retaining personal Memory and avoiding extra model work.

Independent persistent Agents can own scheduled duties without selecting the personal Assistant. Schedule and cancel-schedule use typed service commands; Agent snapshots expose their scheduled_wakes. The Inbox atomically queues due occurrences and advances each duty on its selected cadence, coalesces missed intervals, retains receipts across restart and cancels future duties on Agent archive. Delivery uses native automation input with separate application-tool context.
The local service protocol is 4.9; independent Agent duties use the existing Inbox journal without a new database schema.
